## IQuoteUpdateNotifier

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Domain.Collectors.IQuoteUpdateNotifier</code>. Kind: `interface`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Domain/Collectors/IQuoteUpdateNotifier.cs:9](../../../../src/Meridian.Domain/Collectors/IQuoteUpdateNotifier.cs#L9).

Signals that a symbol&#x27;s in-memory quote state changed, so out-of-band consumers (for example the browser workstation&#x27;s quote-stream fan-out) can react without polling. Implementations MUST be non-blocking and exception-safe: this runs on the market-data ingestion path and must never stall or fail it.
